title_en: Character Riddles (15/20): Fish and Lamb Together
note_en: Chinese describes how intense a quality is by putting 得 after the adjective and then the result: 味道鲜美得让人忍不住多吃了两碗米饭 "the flavor was so delicious that we couldn't resist eating two more bowls of rice," and 新鲜得几乎带着一点甜味 "so fresh it was almost sweet." Where English needs "so… that…," Chinese simply lets 得 introduce the consequence.
